speed.MSE05_limit_rpm: 160 (1st) / 190 (2nd disp.) - 750 cc Classic, Poclain catalog (F1); HighFlow 220/240

axle.gear_seat: Ø150 seat on a stepped axle ASSUMED; keyless locking assembly or shrink fit (supplier sizes); key alt. 36x20x160 on Ø150

pinion_shaft.note: pinion integral with shaft, two bearings in the case; motor shaft drives it by spline, no gear load on the motor (Poclain shaft version)

bearings.selection: pinion: 2 x SKF 22214 E (C0 228 kN; alt. 32214 J2/Q C0 208); case on axle: 2 x SKF 23030 CC/W33 (C0 750 kN; alt. 32030 X C0 655) - SKF catalog (supplier_data_L2 §3); s0>=2 required
bearings.fatigue_note: Running loads are small (35 kW pump allowance: ~2 kN rim per axle at 7.5 mph); bearings are governed by start/peak static loads and the 3 g vertical shock on the axle-hung mass

torque_reaction.type: axle-hung case on 2 suspension bearings + rubber-bushed vertical nose link to the transom underside (classic nose-suspended)
torque_reaction.link: M24 rod-end / rubber-bushed link 2 x Ø60 bushes (AWAIT supplier); bracket PL20 welded to transom bottom PL16
torque_reaction.transom_bracket_weld: 2 x 150 mm 8 fillet: throat 1,697 mm2 -> 17.4 MPa at 1.5 x relief + 3 g (allow 145)
torque_reaction.path: nose link -> transom (Z850-1050) -> inside sideframes Y+/-330-360 -> axleboxes; nothing outside the wheels

packaging.motor: Poclain MSE05 shaft version Ø300 x 360 (incl. flange) ASSUMED from guide Ø300 x 312-370
packaging.inside_frame_window_Y: +/-330 (inside sideframes); package spans Y-255..+265; main rails Y+/-240 are 300 mm higher (Z1150) - not a constraint at axle level
packaging.stagger: case on -Y for axles X3300/6500, mirrored (+Y) for X4850/8050
packaging.brake: axle disc space is taken by the gear case and motor; Ø340x25 disc + spring-applied air-released caliper (>= 22 kN clamp) on the pinion-shaft extension (PE calc B1-g)

pump.limiter: NO hydromechanical limiter on H1P - 35 kW cap by anti-stall software: AC-1/AC-2 automotive control, or EDC + PLUS+1 anti-stall (destroke on engine droop / p×Vg limit) (F2)
pump.pressure: L35: pressure limiter 350 bar + HPRV 400 bar (F3); relief-case torques re-run at 350 (gear rating) and 400 (structural)
pump.charge: charge relief ≤ 30 bar (24-28 bar), Poclain boost window 15-30 bar (F4)
pump.case_drain: dedicated unrestricted motor case-drain line to tank, at/above shaft height; motor case ≤ 1 bar (F5)

motor_shaft.ref: F7 - keyed Ø50 shaft NOT permitted

start_eta.ref: F6 - 0.78 marginal, pending Poclain start torque

brake.caliper_ref: Coremo Ocmea D 3.5N spring-applied air-released (24.2 kN clamp, 19.8 kg) - ref only, AWAIT supplier
brake.release_air: regulated release-air supply off MR: 6 bar max regulator for Coremo (5.1-6 bar) (F9)
brake.commissioning: pad burnish / bedding step before brake tests - initial torque may be 30-50 % below nominal (F8)
brake.parking_option: T04 integral brake parking/hold only, not service (F10)

bearings.ref: F11 / l10_L2.py - life governed by seats + static/shock, not L10
